decisions.reason: Official page explicitly describes a degree program with courses partly provided through the LCMC consortium/Rize partnership. The faculty page identifies a business program director; no separately named Supply Chain Management department established.

sources.note: University identity and explicit supply-chain degree curriculum, consortium delivery and program status.
Lance Cain is assistant professor of business and business program director, not a separately named supply-chain department chair.
Business degree inventory places Supply Chain Management among undergraduate degree programs.
Complete undergraduate inventory read; no industrial engineering program or separate operations academic unit established.

limitations: Supply-chain education is verified, but the imported label names a degree program rather than a separately identified academic unit. No department or school invented from the program name. This finding does not assert an absence of supply-chain teaching.
